### 💡 Proposed Feature or Research Direction
A clear and concise description of what you want to add or improve.

### 🔬 Technical Motivation & Systems Rationale
Why does this matter? What performance, throughput, or architectural bottleneck does it address?

### 📐 Proposed Architecture / API Surface
Any proposed code snippets, kernel hooks, or benchmark designs.

### 🌟 Community Impact
How will this benefit developers, kernel engineers, and the broader open-source ecosystem?
